findings.name: Renaming a question to only spaces blanks the question title and fails silently
findings.summary: The header title area goes completely blank (the question has no visible name any more), no error or validation message appears on screen, and only the console shows a failed request PUT /api/card/40 → 400. After reloading the page the old name 'agent6-renamed-1' comes back, so the rename silently failed while the UI had already dropped the name. (on /question/40-agent6-renamed-1)
findings.expected: Either the rename is refused with a visible message next to the title and the old name stays, or the title is trimmed/validated so a question always keeps a visible name.
findings.actual: The header title area goes completely blank (the question has no visible name any more), no error or validation message appears on screen, and only the console shows a failed request PUT /api/card/40 → 400. After reloading the page the old name 'agent6-renamed-1' comes back, so the rename silently failed while the UI had already dropped the name.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open a saved question, e.g. https://5501-i50b8xmjnfdqmiige5l4r.e2b.app/question/40-agent6-renamed-1 (name 'agent6-renamed-1')
Click the question title in the page header (the editable title field showing 'agent6-renamed-1')
Clear the title completely, type two spaces, and press Enter

findings.name: A query with two statements separated by ';' silently runs only the first, with no warning
findings.summary: The query runs and shows only the first statement's result ("1" with "Showing 1 row"; on the rerun "111" with "Showing 1 row"). The second statement is discarded without any message, warning or indication, and the footer reports a normal, successful run. The same happens with a full-width two-column first statement: only the first column's value is shown as a big number. (on /question (native SQL editor))
findings.expected: Either an error saying that only one statement can be run at a time, or both statements handled with the incomplete run made explicit. Silently running only the first statement and reporting a normal result misleads the person into thinking the whole query ran.
findings.actual: The query runs and shows only the first statement's result ("1" with "Showing 1 row"; on the rerun "111" with "Showing 1 row"). The second statement is discarded without any message, warning or indication, and the footer reports a normal, successful run. The same happens with a full-width two-column first statement: only the first column's value is shown as a big number.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1, click New > SQL query (Sample Database is selected).
Type into the SQL editor: SELECT 1 AS a; SELECT 2 AS b
Click the Run (Get Answer) button, or press Ctrl+Enter in the editor.
Read the result area and the footer row count.
Repeat with SELECT 111 AS first_stmt, 'a' AS tag; SELECT 222 AS second_stmt, 'b' AS tag and run again.

findings.name: The starting-data search box treats "%" as a wildcard and lists every table and question
findings.summary: Typing a single "%" into the box replaces the list with every table, saved question and model in the app (agent6-renamed-1, agent6-copy-1, agent4-count-by-size, Release requests by region and category, People, Orders, Products, agent2-sql-lifecycle, Release requests, Number of Orders, Revenue …), the same as an empty search. The typed text is not matched literally. (on /question/notebook)
findings.expected: The picker should filter on the literal text, or say "No search results" for a character that appears in no name, as it does for "zzzznothing".
findings.actual: Typing a single "%" into the box replaces the list with every table, saved question and model in the app (agent6-renamed-1, agent6-copy-1, agent4-count-by-size, Release requests by region and category, People, Orders, Products, agent2-sql-lifecycle, Release requests, Number of Orders, Revenue …), the same as an empty search. The typed text is not matched literally.
reproSteps: In the 'Pick your starting data' panel, click the search box 'Search for tables and more...'.
Type a single percent sign '%' and wait for the list to update.
Compare with typing 'zzzznothing' in the same box, which correctly shows 'No search results'.
